## Outline

- **(8m) The cold open.** From an empty directory: the raw seven-day up-call
  detection file, one sentence of intent, and the `pa` agent. It reads the file,
  describes the columns, plots calls-per-hour against time of day, and flags
  the diel structure. No narration while it runs.
- **(4m) Pull the curtain back.** What it got right, what it assumed, and the
  one thing in the output that is wrong. Set the tone: impressive is not the
  same as correct.
- **(5m) Welcome and the map.** The three tiers and what you'll leave with.
- **(8m) Setup checkpoint.** `_exercises/01_setup-check/`. Posit AI Pass is a
  sign-in, not a secret, so there are no keys to paste — which is why this is
  eight minutes and not thirty. Posit Cloud is the fallback. Helpers circulate.

## Notes for the instructor

- Pick the deliberate error during dry-run. Do not improvise it.
- Have a recording of this run as a fallback; the first eight minutes are the
  worst possible time for a network failure.
